IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with copper-red braids
and light freckles stands in a golden wheat field
beside a white stork with a red beak. She wears a
red and white embroidered high-necked dress with
a lace collar, several strands of pearls, and a brown
leather strap across her chest. Small silver drop
earrings hang from her ears. Her expression is
calm and direct. Soft daylight, a palette of wheat
gold, crimson, cream, and white. Striking and
poised, in the style of a pastoral editorial.
